description: Caption of one minute of video.

dense_caption.description: A detailed description of what is in the minute, in time order.

events.description: What happens in the minute, one entry per occurrence, in time order, for example someone walks in.

start_s.description: Second 0-59 when it starts; null if unknown.

end_s.description: Second 0-59 when it ends; null if unknown.

type.description: Kind of event, a free string, for example arrive, leave, talk, buy, eat, fight, pick_up, phone_call.

who.description: Who does it; null if nobody or unknown.

unexpected.description: Surprising or striking things that would catch a viewer's attention, for example someone disappears, something breaks, a sudden reveal.

start_s.description: Second 0-59 when it happens; null if unknown.

entities.description: Important people, characters, animals and objects, with their description and state.

name.description: Name as shown or said, or a short description if unnamed.

type.description: Kind of entity, a free string, for example person, character, animal, object, food, vehicle, device.

description.description: Appearance and other details that identify it.

state.description: Its current state, for example full, broken, open, wearing a red coat, injured; null if nothing notable.

places.description: Where the minute takes place, one entry per place.

name.description: Name of the place as shown or said; null if unnamed.

description.description: What the place is and looks like.

actions.description: Actions under way in the minute, each as a hierarchy from the overall activity down to the current step, for example making dinner, then chopping onions.

who.description: Who does it; null if unknown.

hierarchy.description: From the top-level activity to the most specific current action.

relations.description: Relations shown or said, for example who owns what or who is whose sister.

relation.description: A free string, for example owns, sister_of, works_at, friend_of.

transcription.description: The speech of the minute, cleaned and corrected, in its original language; null if nobody speaks.

explanation.description: Why this minute is recorded: its purpose or role in the whole video.

on_screen_text.description: Legible text in the frames, copied exactly.

where.description: Where the text appears, for example sign, subtitle, phone screen, menu.

mood.description: Emotion or atmosphere of the minute, for example happy, tense, sad, calm; null if not clear.
